subject: Request: Exec approval for 25% Hosted API concession — Lifeline Health
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Dawson <emma@lifelinehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-05-10T14:12:00Z
Subject: Proposal: 12mo committed Hosted API rate + one-time onboarding credit

Emma — great conversation earlier. As discussed, Lifeline’s forecast suggests sustained Hosted API usage at ~1.2B tokens/month after ramp. To accelerate the pilot and lock predictable unit economics for you, we can offer a time-limited concession: a 25% reduction off standard Hosted API list rates for a 12-month committed term (min monthly commit of $40k).

Key points:
- Discount: 25% off list per-token Hosted API rate for the 12-month term
- Commit: $40,000/month minimum invoice (billed monthly)
- Onboarding credit: $30k one-time credit to offset migration and integration work
- Quarterly business review and usage-based adjustment clause (safeguard for both sides)

I’ve attached the statement of work (lifeline_sow_v3.docx) and a draft amendment (amendment_25pct.pdf) that lays out the pricing language. Procurement noted that anything over 20% requires senior exec sign-off on our side — I’ll escalate internally but wanted to confirm Lifeline is comfortable with the commit and terms so we can move quickly.

If that aligns, next steps: procurement sends PO and we initiate DocuSign for the amendment.

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0133

Attachment: lifeline_sow_v3.docx (docx)
Attachment: amendment_25pct.pdf (pdf)

From: Emma Dawson <emma@lifelinehealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-05-10T16:18:00Z
Subject: Re: Proposal: 12mo committed Hosted API rate + one-time onboarding credit

Thanks Stephanie — this looks promising. A couple quick clarifications before procurement raises a PO:
- Can you confirm the discount is fixed for the 12 months (no mid-term repricing)?
- Will the onboarding credit be applied to month 1 invoice, or as a separate credit note?

Procurement flagged that their policy requires an internal signatory if the vendor price concession exceeds 20%. They asked that you provide us the exact wording you intend to put in the amendment so they can parallel-review.

We should be able to move quickly once we have official amendment language and an executive OK on your side.

—Emma
Emma Dawson
Head of Platform Partnerships | Lifeline Health
emma@lifelinehealth.com

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-05-11T09:07:00Z
Subject: URGENT: Exec approval request — Lifeline Health asking for 25% Hosted API concession

Team — looping you in. Lifeline (large payer partner) is asking for a 25% Hosted API rate vs list for a 12-month committed term; procurement requires our senior approval because it exceeds 20%. Overview and rationale below.

Account snapshot:
- Lifeline Health — national provider network, piloting Redwood for clinical summarization and patient messaging
- Expected steady-state usage: ~1.2B tokens/month post-ramp (Q3 onward)
- Proposed economics: 25% off list, $40k/month minimum commit, $30k onboarding credit
- Upside: renewal potential at 18–24 months with multi-region expansion and Dedicated evaluation; logo of strategic value for payer GTM

Risks/controls suggested:
- 12-month term with minimum monthly invoice (no retroactive credits if usage below commit)
- Quarterly business review checkpoints (product + finance) with right to adjust if usage materially changes
- Amendment includes clause preventing stacking with other promotional credits

Attachments: amendment_25pct.pdf (text for procurement), usage_forecast_q3_q4.xlsx (internal forecast) — both attached.

Ask: Marcus — can you sign off on a 25% concession under these conditions? If you approve, I’ll instruct legal to finalize the amendment and send DocuSign; procurement will route PO once they have the signed amendment. If you prefer a counter (e.g., 22% + larger commit), I can loop Emma immediately.

Thanks — appreciate a quick call if helpful.

—Stephanie

Stephanie — thank you for the clear context and the guardrails. I approve the 25% concession for Lifeline Health under the stated conditions: 12-month term, $40k/month minimum, one-time $30k onboarding credit, quarterly business reviews, and amendment language that prevents stacking with other offers. Please ensure Legal adds a clause that we can re-evaluate pricing on renewal and that usage verification is auditable (for commit enforcement).

I’d also ask Finance to model worst-case revenue impact vs. the strategic value case — Ben please run a sensitivity for the board packet. Karthik, loop the deployment team to confirm we can meet the regional latency SLAs if they go multi-region.

Once Legal routes the amendment, send me a DocuSign link for signature and confirm we’ve captured the PO number in the HubSpot deal.
